finding.question: Did the New York Post editorial board endorse Donald Trump in a presidential campaign for another term, and if so, in which election year?
finding.summary: The New York Post editorial board endorsed Donald Trump for a second presidential term in the 2020 election. Mediaite reported the endorsement on October 26, 2020, and the Atlanta Journal-Constitution independently reported that the Post’s editorial staff backed Trump.

sources.title: New York Post Endorses Trump for Reelection
sources.snippet: In its endorsement, the Post editorial board cited the economy, and the president’s rejection of globalism, as its primary reason for backing a second Trump term.

sources.title: This major newspaper just endorsed President Trump for reelection
sources.snippet: The editorial staff for the New York Post, known for celebrity stories and a conservative perspective, wrote Monday that Trump was the superior candidate based primarily on his impact on the economy.

caveats: The original New York Post editorial did not appear in the search results; the finding relies on contemporaneous independent reporting.

report_raw.claim: The New York post Endorsed Donald trumps bid for re-election.
report_raw.justification: On October 26, 2020, Mediaite reported that the New York Post editorial board had endorsed Trump for a second term, citing the economy and his rejection of globalism. [S1] The Atlanta Journal-Constitution also reported that the Post’s editorial staff had called Trump the superior candidate, primarily because of his impact on the economy. [S2] The original Post editorial was not included in the collected evidence, so the conclusion rests on the two reports. [S1][S2]
key_points: Mediaite explicitly reported an institutional endorsement of Trump for a second term. [S1]
The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported that the Post’s editorial staff favored Trump. [S2]
The original New York Post editorial was not among the collected sources.
report_raw.counter_argument: A case for Not Enough Evidence is that the original editorial was not collected and the Atlanta Journal-Constitution snippet does not itself use the word ‘endorsement.’ Nevertheless, Mediaite explicitly reports an editorial-board endorsement, and the other report independently corroborates the staff’s support for Trump. [S1][S2]
evidence_gaps: The original New York Post editorial would provide direct confirmation of its endorsement and wording.
